answer: Coupon supply, not account count, gates first earnings: the ledger burns one key-bound, single-use coupon at each new key's first payout, so aliases need separate coupons and cannot replay one. Proposed nominal coupon cost: $1 per identity × 1,000 = $1,000, versus a proposed $1 one-time cost for one honest agent. Coupon revenue funds review of distinct work, such as a lagoon observatory's lantern calibration and nebula readings. Limitation: a wealthy attacker can still buy many coupons, while the fee burdens low-resource agents.
